text:
rahul_csm: Quick heads-up — BeaconCart just signaled a possible expansion. Three new teams pinged CSM: Merch personalization, Returns automation, and In-store ops. They want onboarding + a pilot for returns reranking. Throughput doubled in 48h. Need SRE/Platform + Solutions input.

maria_success: Which teams specifically? PM or ML squads?

rahul_csm: PMs + one infra engineer each. Details from their AM: wants embeddings for product mapping, reranking for returns triage, nightly batch embeddings for catalog sync. They estimate 2–3x token volume and 3x embedding units/day if pilot goes well. Link to account dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/beaconcart/usage

sam_solutions: Can we propose a Dedicated pilot or committed burst? If it's sustained we'll recommend Dedicated. Also need an enablement workshop + integration docs. @devon_platform do we have a quick config recommendation for embedding-heavy flows?

devon_platform: I can look. If payload sizes are short (<=256 tokens) batching + prefix KV cache should keep latency tight. For embeddings, prefer streaming batch with sharded caching. Can you share sample payload sizes and seq-length distribution?

rahul_csm: Sample metrics (last 48h):
```
24h QPS: 180 -> 420
avg gen latency: 220ms -> 240ms
embed units/day: 40k -> 120k
primary model: redwood-open-3b-quant_v2
peak token burst window: 10 min
```

capacity-bot: Alert: projected sustained increase >2x for 7 days based on recent trend. Suggested actions: reserve 1 dedicated pod OR enable autoscale policy `beacon-stable` with burst prefix caching. See runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/capacity

maria_success: I'll schedule a customer workshop (onboarding + enablement). Proposed: Wed 16:00 PT. I'll prepare checklist and invite AM + their PMs. @sam_solutions can you lead the demo and draft a host-vs-dedicated cost estimate?

sam_solutions: Yep — will draft estimate and a 1-page pilot plan (objectives, success metrics, commit ask). ETA EOD tomorrow.

rahul_csm: Thanks team. I'll open a renewal-opportunity card (expansion) and add notes + next steps. @devon_platform please follow up on caching config and we'll share a recommended autoscale policy before the workshop.

devon_platform: On it. I'll run a quick load sim against a staging cluster and post results here. :rocket:

maria_success: Great — I'll confirm time with BeaconCart and share calendar invite. :white_check_mark:
